description: This PHP source file defines a 'EmployeeModel' class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Pim plugin API. The class implements the 'Normalizable' interface, uses traits for serialization, and constructs an employee data model by wrapping an Employee entity, including properties like employee number, last name, first name, middle name, employee ID, and termination ID.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: A model class representing employee data, implementing serialization and normalization for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeModel with an Employee entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings.
